steps.en: Add the package to your React app
steps.zh: 把这个包加进你的 React 应用

steps.en: List the steps: which element to point at and what to say
steps.zh: 列出步骤：指向哪个元素、说什么

steps.en: Render the tour and switch it on
steps.zh: 渲染引导组件并打开开关

steps.en: Waits for each target, scrolls it into view, draws the overlay, spotlight and tooltip
steps.zh: 等目标出现，滚进视口，画遮罩、聚光和气泡

steps.en: Advances on Next/Back/Skip with focus trapped, re-tracking targets that move
steps.zh: 随下一步/上一步/跳过推进，锁住焦点，目标移动就重新跟踪

steps.en: Reports every transition to your handler so app state can steer the tour
steps.zh: 每次切换都回调给你，应用状态可以反过来驱动引导

value.en: A product tour that lives as a React component, tracking re-renders instead of fighting them
value.zh: 引导成为一个 React 组件，跟着重渲染走而不是和它打架

sources: gilbarbara/react-joyride README.md (main, retrieved 2026-10-08): npm i react-joyride; steps array { target: '.my-first-step', content: 'This is my awesome feature!' }; <Joyride run steps={steps} />; useJoyride hook
